summary: The change fixes the analyzer crash for [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] types with invalid contracts: after reporting a mixed-key diagnostic it now skips the member, and duplicate-key dictionary inserts are guarded so duplicate keys no longer throw. All 8 new targeted analyzer/execution tests pass and the build passes. However, the same diff changes deserializing constructor parameter matching (`ctorParamIndex = 1`) for all types, breaking six previously-passing tests in the full suite, and the fail-without-fix check was not run, so the fix's test coverage is unverified and the change currently introduces regressions.

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: The contract-diagnostic tests for suppressed types pass (missing key MsgPack004, member type MsgPack003, allow-private MsgPack015), and the code still reports these diagnostics via reportDiagnostic; the fix keeps the analyzer from crashing while reporting them.
SourceGenerationOnlyDiagnosticsAreNotReportedWhenSuppressed passes, confirming that source-generation-only checks (partial-class, AOT-only) are not raised for a suppressed type.

The three WithoutAnalyzerFailure tests (duplicate int keys, duplicate string keys, mixed key kinds) pass on head, demonstrating the analyzer no longer crashes on invalid contracts for suppressed types; the full-suite failures are unrelated constructor/generation regressions covered in finding N1.

findings.title: Change breaks six previously-passing tests (regression)
findings.claim: The full suite reports six tests that pass on base but fail on head (GenerationTests.DeserializingConstructorParameterMemberTypeAssignability_Incompatible, GenerationTests.DeserializingConstructorParameterMemberTypeAssignability_MemberAssignsToParamType, GenerationTests.NoPrivateAccessNeeded, GenerationTests.NonDefaultDeserializingConstructor_Private, MsgPack00xAnalyzerTests.AddAttributeToTypeForRecordPrimaryConstructor, MsgPack00xAnalyzerTests.AddAttributesToMembersOfRecordWithPrimaryCtor). This violates REQ-2234-N2's 'no regressions' and blocks merging. The likely cause is the constructor-parameter index change (`ctorParamIndex = 1` at head line 1241 vs `0` at base line 1227), which alters deserializing-constructor matching for all types, not just SuppressSourceGeneration types.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert or scope the ctorParamIndex change, then re-run the full suite and tests.fail_without_fix before merging.
